title.zh: Underdog把Qwen3.8-27B压到7.89GB：工具调用自测超过原版
title.en: Underdog把Qwen3.8-27B压到7.89GB：工具调用自测超过原版

current_state.zh: Underdog released Saluki 27B, a ~2-bit quantized derivative of Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B that shrinks from ~54GB to 7.89GB, runs on 16GB laptops, and reportedly beats the original on a 120-question tool-calling benchmark while retaining ~96% of its average benchmark score.
